headline: REDEMPLO revenue ramp continues, losses widen on R&D
summary_short: Arrowhead's revenue rose 171% y/y and 2.1% q/q to $75.3M on continued REDEMPLO U.S. launch momentum, while net loss attributable to the company widened to $194.3M (-$1.36 diluted EPS) as R&D and SG&A spending increased.
summary_long: Revenue grew 2.1% q/q and 171% y/y to $75.3M as REDEMPLO's U.S. launch kept building momentum — prescription volume roughly doubled during the quarter with over 400 unique prescribers now on board — plus new EC and Australian TGA marketing authorizations. R&D expense rose to $198.2M (from $162.4M y/y) and SG&A to $47.1M (from $30.9M y/y), widening the operating loss 20.4% q/q to $170.1M. Net loss attributable to Arrowhead widened 46.4% q/q and 10.9% y/y to $194.3M ($1.36 diluted loss per share), partly reflecting a $15.4M net-income allocation to noncontrolling interest this quarter versus a $3.4M loss allocation a year ago. Stockholders' equity fell 24.2% q/q to $465.5M. No forward financial guidance was given in this release.
